title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1978-04-06
lineage: Transfer: DAT > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16-bit/44.1k - Transferred by Charlie Miller Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16
source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a Godchaux‑era show, highlighted by a killer drum‑to‑Other One transition and a superb Big River jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the magic of the Godchaux years shine through. Musically the performance stands out with an electrifying drum roll into The Other One and a thrilling, keyboard‑rich rendition of Big River. Both reviewers praised these moments, making this release a must‑listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive (4–5 stars) and highlight strong musical moments plus excellent soundboard quality; limited to two reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp soundboard capture noted as "great quality" with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong momentum with seamless transitions, especially the killer drum‑to‑Other One segue and a flowing Big River jam.

band_member_comments.Keys: Nice keyboard work highlighted on the Big River performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Killer transition from drums into The Other One praised by reviewers.
